column1: ! emily-symbols. Every combination of the six fields. The expectations were
! emily-symbols.py's own answers, taken while that dictionary was still the
! definition. This grammar is the definition now, so the file is the expectation
! and there is nothing to regenerate it from: a line that changes is a change to
! what a symbol writes, so read it and then update it.
! both halves of the identifier are required, so these have no entry
